problems: The bridge floats. It is a thin box at y -0.083 to -0.093, but the top plate under it is at about y -0.058, so it touches neither the body nor the strings, which cross it at y -0.119. A violin bridge stands on its feet on the top plate, at right angles to it, and holds the strings up. The fix rebuilds it as a box that is tall along -y, from the plate (y -0.057) up to the strings (y -0.12).
